semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Header indicating the start of a list of enclosures or attachments to the proposal document.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: This node functions as a section header that categorizes subsequent items as required attachments. It establishes the context for 'Appendix to Proposal' and 'Schedule of Cost Indexation' as specific enclosure types.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Primary structural marker defining the 'Enclosure(s)' category within the proposal submission requirements.

semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Specific item listed under the Enclosures, identified as an Appendix to the Proposal.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: This node represents a specific instance of an enclosure. It is logically continued from the general 'ENCLOSURE(S):' header, specifying one of the documents that must be attached.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Represents a specific content element (Appendix) belonging to the broader Enclosure category defined by the preceding header.
